sources.title: What Is an AI Visibility Index? Scoring and Examples
sources.snippet: An AI Visibility Index measures whether AI systems include, cite or recommend a business when people ask for the best products, services or providers in a market. Plain-English definition: An AI Visibility Index is a structured score that summarizes how visible a business or brand is across AI-generated recommendations.
